question: Under EU Schengen rules, how many days may a visa-exempt non-EU short-stay visitor spend in the Schengen area within any 180-day period?
answer: A visa-exempt non-EU short-stay visitor may spend **no more than 90 days in any 180-day period** in the Schengen Area. The 180-day period is a ** მოძრিং window**, counted backward from each day of stay; both entry and exit days count. [[1, 2]]
